review:
A cat queen in Ancient Egypt, with wilds carrying 2x or 3x multipliers. The base-game hook: a full stack of cats on reel one makes every wild and matching cat sticky, then respins until a line wins.

Three, four or five scatters give 8, 12 or 16 free spins where every wild sticks to the end, and a full stack of cats on reel one adds two more spins. Up to 5,000x, 96.2% RTP. Classic lines with sticky features.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
